class.name: tops_controllers/CartesianImpedanceController
class.description: Cartesian impedance control for a 7-DOF Panda: a programmable spring-damper in task space, with dynamically consistent null-space posture control, wrench filtering and force regulation, slew-limited gain scheduling, and an energy-tank passivity monitor. Commands joint torque; runs in the controller_manager update loop at 1 kHz.

class.name: tops_controllers/CartesianAdmittanceController
class.description: Cartesian admittance control: the opposite causality to the impedance controller. Measures the wrist wrench, integrates a virtual mass-spring-damper to produce a reference pose, and tracks it with a stiff inner loop on the same effort interfaces. Exists so the impedance-versus-admittance comparison can be measured rather than asserted.
